data.rationale: jcv_ceil needs the truncated integer result to be finite to prove that adding 1.0f doesn't overflow (rte_28) and that its own result is finite.
jcv_ceil needs to know the truncation is <= the original value to prove ceiling semantics (result >= v).
jcv_ceil declares assigns nothing and needs jcv_real_to_int to also not modify any memory.
